title: DeepMind Releases Gemini Robotics ER 2, Unlocking Multi-robot Collaboration for the First Time

content_html:
At a time when humanoid robots are accelerating their deployment, the iteration speed of AI "brains" has once again refreshed industry perceptions. A relevant team has recently officially launched a new embodied reasoning model - Gemini Robotics ER2. As a core driving system specifically designed for hardware devices, this model not only advances in physical environment understanding and multi-step task planning, but also successfully solves the challenge of multi-robot collaboration at the technical level for the first time.

Since the introduction of the related embodied intelligence system, the development team has continuously accelerated product iterations. After the evolution of previous versions, the new ER2 model has made breakthroughs in real-time decision-making and continuous task monitoring. Unlike traditional reasoning models that require "pausing to think" before executing actions, this model allows robots to plan their next steps while maintaining movement.

Through deep integration with real-time voice interaction interfaces, hardware devices can process continuous tasks more smoothly, significantly reducing intermediate stutters and pauses. At the same time, the new model has the ability to continuously understand video content, not only evaluating task progress in real-time, capturing error-prone steps during execution, but also directly retrying problematic steps, eliminating the cumbersome process of resetting the entire workflow. Test data shows that the model demonstrates extremely high accuracy in task progress classification and key event timing identification.

Notably, the model has officially introduced a multi-robot collaboration mechanism. Relying on this technical foundation, different forms and functions of robots can share environmental data and efficiently achieve division of labor handoffs. In an official test demonstration, the relevant humanoid robots and robotic arm platforms successfully collaborated, vividly demonstrating the capabilities of cross-device collaborative operations.

Currently, the model is open to the industry through APIs and developer platforms, and is also undergoing private testing on enterprise-level Agent platforms, marking a solid step forward for embodied intelligence toward large-scale commercialization.

content_html_zh:
在人形机器人加速部署之际，AI“大脑”的迭代速度再次刷新行业认知。 相关团队最近正式推出了新的具身推理模型——Gemini Robotics ER2。 作为专门为硬件设备设计的核心驱动系统，该模型不仅在物理环境理解和多步任务规划方面取得了进步，而且首次在技术层面成功解决了多机器人协作的挑战。

自相关具身智能系统推出以来，开发团队不断加速产品迭代。 经过之前版本的演进，新的ER2模型在实时决策和持续任务监控方面取得了突破。 与在执行行动之前需要“暂停思考”的传统推理模型不同，该模型允许机器人在保持运动的同时规划下一步的步骤。

通过与实时语音交互界面的深度集成，硬件设备可以更流畅地处理连续任务，显着减少中间的卡顿和停顿。 同时，新模型具有持续理解视频内容的能力，不仅可以实时评估任务进度，捕获执行过程中容易出错的步骤，还可以直接重试有问题的步骤，省去了重置整个工作流程的繁琐过程。 测试数据表明，该模型在任务进度分类和关键事件时序识别方面表现出极高的准确性。

值得注意的是，该模型正式引入了多机器人协作机制。 依托这一技术基础，不同形态、功能的机器人可以共享环境数据，高效实现分工交接。 在官方测试演示中，相关人形机器人与机械臂平台成功协作，生动地展示了跨设备协同操作的能力。

目前，该模型已通过API和开发者平台向业界开放，并正在企业级Agent平台进行内测，标志着实体智能向大规模商业化迈出了坚实的一步。
